scope.schema: Existing authored question schema; four options; zero-based correct index

validation.lengthGiveawayReview: No item was retained solely because the correct option was longer; options were written with comparable grammatical structure and distractors were made factually plausible. Central audit should recompute spread and semantic plausibility.

contentReview.style: Single-stem, four-option MCQs modelled on the SAI annexure's lower-case a–d presentation; stored options remain plain strings for the existing renderer.
contentReview.mix: 32 foundational and 8 applied items; applied items use medal-composition, scheduling, comparison or interpretation contexts.
contentReview.distractors: Distractors are alternate host cities, years, medal compositions, organisations or event outcomes that are independently plausible in this syllabus area and use comparable grammatical forms.
contentReview.currentFactPolicy: Historical questions preserve their event year. Current host, date and programme statements are explicitly as-of 2026-08-16.
knownCaveats: The official OCA page labels the event Hangzhou 2023 while the Games are commonly called Hangzhou 2022; question 31 tests this distinction and explains the postponement.
